title: Officers keep saying 'don't worry about Michael Johnson'
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: some more and every time I ask about Michael Johnson they tell they kept telling me don't worry about Michael Johnson he's fine he's

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a nuclear weapons guard named Mario Woods kept asking his superiors what had happened to a fellow guard, Michael Johnson, and kept being told, "don't worry about Michael Johnson, he's fine." Woods tells this himself, as part of his account of being taken during a UFO encounter, and he names a Colonel Spraker among the officers involved. If true, it would mean the Air Force was keeping quiet about what happened to the men that night.
